content: Yoobu u Yinni Gusunɔ wisɑ u nɛɛ,

content.text: nɑ yɛ̃ mɑ kɑɑ kpĩ ɑ kpuro ko.
Gɑ̃ɑnu kun kpɛ̃ nu wunɛn himbɑ ɡɔsiɑ.
A ɡeruɑ ɑ nɛɛ, nɑ derɑ tɔmbu bɑ ǹ wunɛn himbɑ tubumɔ kɑ nɛn wiirɑ ɡɑri.
Nɑ wurɑ. Nɑ ɡɑri ɡeruɑ yi nɑ ǹ yɛ̃.
Gɑri yi, yi mɑn kpɑ̃ɑru kere.
n nun swɑɑ dɑkio kpɑ ɑ mɑn ɡɑri sɔ̃.
Kɑɑ mɑn ɡɑri bikiɑ, kpɑ n nun yi tubusiɑ.
Nɑ rɑɑ wunɛn ɡɑri nuɑ yi tɔmbɑ ɡerumɔ,
ɑdɑmɑ tɛ̃ nɑ nun wɑ kɑ nɔni.
Yen sɔ̃nɑ nɑ tii tɑɑrɛ wɛ̃
mɑ nɑ ɡɔ̃ru ɡɔsiɑ nɑ tii tuɑ kɑ torom wisi nuku sɑnkirɑnun sɔ̃.

content: Sɑnɑm mɛ Yinni Gusunɔ u kɑ Yoobu ɡɑri kuɑ u kpɑ, yerɑ u Elifɑsi Temɑɡii sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, nɑ kɑ wunɛ kɑ wunɛn bɔrɔbɑ yiru ye mɔru mɔ̀ too too. Domi i ǹ nɛn ɡɑri ɡeruɑ dee dee nɡe mɛ nɛn bɔ̃ɔ Yoobu u ɡeruɑ.

Yen sɔ̃, i seewo i nɑɑ kinɛnu nɔɔbɑ yiru kɑ yɑ̃ɑ kinɛnu nɔɔbɑ yiru suɑ i kɑ dɑ nɛn bɔ̃ɔ Yoobun mi, i kɑ yɑ̃ku dɔ̃ɔ mwɑɑrɑruɡinu ko. Kpɑ u bɛɛ kɑnɑru kuɑ. Kon kɑnɑ te mwɑ. Kpɑ n ku mɑɑ bɛɛ kuɑ ye kon dɑɑ bɛɛ kuɑ bɛɛn wiirɑ ɡɑrin sɔ̃. Domi i ǹ nɛn ɡɑri ɡeruɑ dee dee nɡe mɛ Yoobu u ɡeruɑ.
Yerɑ Elifɑsi Temɑɡii kɑ Bilidɑ Suɑɡii kɑ Sofɑɑ Nɑɑmɑɡii bɑ seewɑ bɑ dɑ bɑ kuɑ nɡe mɛ Yinni Gusunɔ u bu sɔ̃ɔwɑ bu ko. Mɑ Yinni Gusunɔ u Yoobun kɑnɑru mwɑ.
Ye u kɑnɑ te kuɑ win bɔrɔbɑn sɔ̃ u kpɑ, yerɑ Yinni Gusunɔ u nùn win yellun wɑ̃ɑru wesiɑ, u nùn ye u rɑɑ mɔn subɑ yiru wɛ̃.

Yoobun wɔnɔbu kɑ win mɑɑbu kɑ win sesubu kɑ win yellun bɔrɔbɑ bɑ nùn berɑm dɑ mɑ bɑ di mi kɑ wi sɑnnu. Mɑ bɑ win wɔnwɔndu wɑ, bɑ nùn nukuru yɛmiɑsiɑ nɔni swɑ̃ɑ te Yinni Gusunɔ u derɑ u wɑn sɔ̃. Yerɑ ben bɑɑwure u nùn sii ɡeesun ɡobi kɑ tɑɑbu wurɑɡuu kɑ̃.

Gusunɔ u nùn domɑru kuɑ win sɑnɑm dɑ̃ɑkim mɛ sɔɔ n kere win yellun wɑ̃ɑru. Win ɑrumɑni ye u wɑ wee, yɑ̃ɑnu nɔrɔbun subɑ wɔkurɑ nnɛ (14.000) kɑ yooyoosu nɔrɔbun subɑ nɔɔbɑ tiɑ (6.000) kɑ nɑɑ wuku nɔrɔbun subɑ yiru (2.000) kɑ kɛtɛku ninu nɔrɔbu (1.000).
Yen biru u mɑɑ bii tɔn durɔbu nɔɔbɑ yiru mɑrɑ kɑ bii tɔn kurɔbu itɑ.
U win bii wɔndiɑ ɡbiikoo yĩsiru kɑ̃ Yemimɑ, yiruse mɑɑ Kɛsiɑ, itɑse mɑɑ Kerɛni Hɑpuku.
Tem mi kpuro sɔɔ, wɔndiɑ ɡoo sɑri wi u Yoobun bii wɔndiɑ be burɑm turɑ. U bu tubi wɛ̃ nɡe mɛ u win bii tɔn durɔbu wɛ̃.
Yenibɑn biru, Yoobu u mɑɑ kuɑ wɔ̃ɔ wunɑɑ weeru (140). Mɑ u win bibu wɑ kɑ win debuminun bibu.
Yoobu u tɔkɔ kuɑ kɔ̃ɔ kɔ̃ɔ mɑ u kpunɑ u ɡu.
